headline: Commissary Staff

experience.title: Commissary Staff
experience.employer: Davao de Oro Bakeshop and Snack Chain
bullets: Prepare dough fillings, sauces and ready-to-cook items for 12 branch stores.
Pack and seal products in portions and label them for delivery.
Store incoming ingredients and count stock at the end of each week.
Load delivery vans with branch orders early each morning.
Serve customers at the store counter when the branch is short-staffed.

experience.title: Service Crew
bullets: Took orders, served food and cleaned the dining area.
Helped prepare simple meals in the kitchen during rush hours.

summary: Commissary staff with three years preparing and packing food for a bakeshop and snack chain in Davao de Oro. I prepare ingredients in bulk, pack and label products for the branches, and help with storage and stock counts. I work fast and follow safe work practices.

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Home Economics strand
education.school: Davao de Oro Valley Integrated School
